text:
jamal: quick sync — proposal: push RBAC enforcement from projection/post-filter into the query planner. want to capture tradeoffs and a rollout plan.
priya: whoa. that changes a lot of our assumptions. what's the main win?
jamal: three concrete wins: 1) avoid doing heavy aggregation work that will be thrown away by post-filtering, 2) get realistic cost estimates so the scheduler can make better slot decisions, 3) allow earlier SLO-aware short-circuits for unauthorized panels.
zoe: big question: can planner-pushdown exactly match post-filter semantics (row-level filters, column redaction, implicit tenant joins)?
jamal: we'd aim for semantic parity. plan to run a compatibility mirror mode for a configurable % of queries to compare outputs.
arun: planner complexity: we need to represent auth as plan annotations and possibly rewrite predicates into pushable predicates. plus need to ensure non-pushable parts still get covered by post-filter fallback.
priya: cache implications? our panel tile cache keys today are tenant+panel+params. if enforcement moves, cached tiles could become stale/incorrect.
jamal: change: include an auth-signature in cache key when tenant has mutable policies. default behavior for static-policy tenants remains tenant-only key.
zoe: that reduces blast radius. still worried about cache cardinality explosion for customers with many dynamic ACLs.
arun: mitigation: only include auth-signature when the tenant's effective permission set size > 1 or flagged via metadata. also support a ttl-lift for auth-keyed tiles to avoid churn.
priya: rollout plan?
jamal: suggested stages:
- alpha: planner emits AuthGuard annotations but doesn't enforce (opt-in flag). collect telemetry.
- beta: enable enforcement for internal/small tenants and run legacy post-filter in parallel for sampling.
- cache: flip cache-keying for selected tenants, monitor hit/miss.
- ramp: expand enforcement as mismatch rate stays low.
zoe: telemetry we need to monitor:
- per-panel latency p50/p95 before vs after
- CPU and GPU tokens consumed per render
- cache hit-rate by key-type (tenant-only vs tenant+auth)
- sampled diff rate between planner path and legacy post-filter (by panel)
- auth-eval latency (compute effective permissions)
priya: add alert: if sampled diff rate > 0.05% sustained for 10m, trigger auto-disable and incident page.
jamal: security note: telemetry must not leak predicates. we'll send predicate digests only (sha256) and store raw samples encrypted with restricted access.
arun: implementation sketch:
```
// in planner
AuthGuard { policy_id: String, pushdown_expr: Expr }
plannode.attach_auth_guard(AuthGuard)
// executor checks guard: if pushable -> apply early filter, else fallback to legacy path
```
priya: will SDKs or public APIs change?
jamal: no. client surface stays exactly the same. this is an internal planner/executor change.
zoe: testing & evals: create an "rbac-planner" eval shard. daily regression runs with a curated corpus + sampled tenant traffic. produce a diff ledger.
jamal: fallback behavior: any planner auth error -> emit metric -> fall back to post-filter path and mark the request with a debug flag. fallback should be safe-by-default.
deploy-bot: note: feature flag controls enforcement. config-service toggle + rolling restart of console-query-workers.
arun: ops concern: sampling/parallel runs will double query work for some traffic; ensure throttles to keep cost delta acceptable. start with <0.5% traffic sampling.
priya: docs needed: a short security whitepaper on predicate digesting, ops runbook for cache-cutover, and QA checklist. I can handle security doc.
zoe: I'll own eval shard and regression tests.
jamal: i'll open the RFC follow-up PR that wires feature flags, planner annotations, and a telemetry dashboard skeleton. followups:
- jamal: PR with planner annotations + feature flag wiring
- arun: cache key plumbing + runbook + throttle knobs
- priya: security telemetry doc + alert thresholds
- zoe: eval shard + diff ledger implementation

jamal: tentative timeline: alpha in 2 weeks, canary for small tenants in 3–4 weeks, wider ramp 6–10 weeks depending on mismatches.
priya: okay. i'll schedule a restart window with infra.
zoe: thumbs up. :rocket:
